unsupported: The Joseph Company operates from Houston, Texas, where it was founded in 1990 by the Joseph family.
Today it remains a family-owned workshop dedicated to custom craftsmanship, building each piece in its own shop.
The company works exclusively with the design trade, serving interior designers, architects, and specifiers who require tailored furnishings for residential and commercial projects.
Its client base consists of design professionals seeking collaborative development of unique pieces that meet exact specifications.
The firm's differentiator is the combination of heritage craftsmanship and a made-to-order approach.
